column1: # Rules of dm/tools/log_digest.py: what a line of an Android run log (or of its logcat) means, in one sentence a player understands. One rule a row, tab-separated:
#   kind   crash | fatal | red | driver | oom | hang | perf | info (the verdict uses the first matching rule of its own kind, in this file's order: specific rules first)
#   regex  searched in each line; must be valid in both Python re and Java java.util.regex (the launcher reads this table too): no named groups, no \Z, no (?P...),
#          no inline flags except a leading (?i) or a scoped (?i:...)
#   doc    a repository-relative link to the entry that explains it (file#anchor), or empty

column4: cause
The GPU stopped responding (a frame did not finish in time), so the game had to close.
The GPU driver lost the device, so nothing more could be drawn.
The GPU did not finish its work for seconds; the driver may be stuck.
A texture upload did not finish in time; the GPU or its driver was stuck.
The game process ran out of memory (an allocation failed).
An allocation in the host failed (std::bad_alloc): the process ran out of memory.
Android's low-memory killer ended the game: the phone ran out of memory.
A line says the game or the host ran out of memory.
The game stopped making progress and the watchdog (DM_WATCH_STALL) ended it.
The run's time limit or watchdog (SIGALRM) ended it.
The game did not finish its own exit in time and was ended at once.

column3: game called nn::diag abort|FATAL game aborted
column4: The game's own code stopped itself (nn::diag abort): something it needed did not behave as on the console.

column3: FATAL the game files .* (are missing|are not a complete RomFS image|cannot be used as a NUP package)
column4: The game files are missing or unreadable: check the game folder or .nup in the launcher.
A file the pack should have is missing: prepare the pack again.

column3: TLS_SLOT_APP .*another library uses the slot|thread slot layout mismatch
column4: Another library on this phone uses the thread slot the host needs, so the host cannot run here.
The game's code lacks a symbol the host needs: the pack does not fit this host.
The game's memory block could not be reserved at its address.
The save folder has an unfinished swap the host refuses to touch; move the marker away to use the save.
The game reached something the app cannot handle yet, so it was stopped.
The game crashed while another thread held the log, so only the crash address was written.
The game crashed reading or writing memory it should not (SIGSEGV).
The game crashed on a bad memory access (SIGBUS).
The game crashed on an instruction this CPU does not run (SIGILL).
The game crashed on a trap instruction (SIGTRAP).
The process aborted (SIGABRT): the lines just before the crash say who called abort.
The app ran into an error and had to close the game.
Android reports a fatal signal in the game process.

column3: no shader library at .*nothing is drawn|shader library .* refused
column4: The pack has no usable shader library for this app, so nothing is drawn: update the shaders in the app.
The pack's shaders are from before versioned updates and may draw wrong: update the shaders once in the app.

column3: its rewrite did not finish|Prepare again remakes it
column4: The pack's code was not finished: use Prepare again on the game.
A DLC folder of the dump could not be linked for the game.
env.txt exists but the app cannot read it, so the run had no switches: chmod 666 it.
Some environment lines set the game's paths and were not taken.
The phone was hot and slowed its CPU or GPU down; frame rate drops follow.

column3: Paused: the phone is too hot
column4: Prepare paused because the phone reported it was too hot.

column3: this host's version \w+ is missing \(the app's shader update makes it\)
column4: The pack's shaders are an older version; the app's shader update makes the current one.
The game sees no DLC; if you own some, check the dump's dlc folder.
The game ended by itself (a normal exit).
